📋 TUESDAY 18 AUGUST 2026 — LEGS DAY WORKOUT SHEET

[HEADER]
Session: Legs & Calves (Quad, Hamstrings, Calves)
Time Cap: 45 Mins Max | Salt Ayre Gym
Hydration: 1.5L water + 1 electrolyte tab pre-gym
Breathing: Continuous exhale on push/flex (RPE 7-8 max, NO Valsalva breath-holding)
Upper Body Rule: Keep chest/shoulders completely relaxed on Leg Extensions (NO hard bracing into handles)
Cardio Rule: ZERO bike/cardio on Legs Day (Preserve lower body glycogen & prevent extreme nausea)

[EXERCISES]
